## source_to_kb
**Variants / parameters (all 6 tiers, all 47 keys).** Each key was checked against the cards:
- plan_price_card: price, bundle %, standalone, fleet volume 10 / 0.08.
- term_and_visit_schedule: visits, term months/miles, interval, tolerance, day spacing.
- included_services_menu: oil type/quarts, extra quart, surcharge, the six per-visit switches, filter/wiper visit lists, brake/coolant/alignment.
- visit_honoring_and_grace: store scope, grace days/miles, defer switch, reinstatement window, substitutions.
- vehicle_eligibility_limits: buyer, conditions, age, odometer, diesel, plans per vehicle.
- cancellation_terms_schedule: free look, refund method, retail value, fee, the six common switches.

Every value matches (e.g. Plus 8: 699.00 / 0.05 / 48 mo / 45000 / 60-day free look / 124.95 / 75.00; Fleet: 1029.00 / 36 / 75000 / 45 days / 30-day / pro rata / 94.95 / 25.00 / 1 substitution). No value is missing or altered.

**Base policies.**
- multi_holding: plans_held_per_customer (exception for fleet substitution carried).
- fleet_volume: fleet_volume_pricing clauses 1–4 + "The count is taken at the handling date" (= msr_active_fleet_plans).
- evt_sale: plan_sale_rules §§1–5 (eligibility, dedup, "judged from the system's plan records" = authority system_record, bundle price, term with month-end rule, loading).
- visit_redemption: visit_redemption_standard (active, term-or-grace with the AND conditions, spacing by interval−tolerance OR days, last visit = msr_last_visit, store scope, services, fulfilment).
- reinstatement: redemption_reinstatement (window day 0, inclusive, once only, closed plans counted unused).
- expiration: plan_expiry_terms.
- cancellation_refund: cancellation_and_refund_clauses 1–10 (free look on visits used = redeemed − reinstated; unwound; 7(a)/(b); fee waiver; floor; no billing; precedence).
- refund_payment: refund_payment_terms (period, one payment, lienholder payee, 0.00 not paid, once per calculation).
- combo_factory_maintenance: factory_maintenance_coordination.
- fleet_substitution: fleet_unit_substitution clauses 1–4.

All equivalent at entailment level.

**Retired surface (overwrite).**
- fleet_volume clause 1: fleet_volume_pricing "Status of clause 1 ... no longer in force for a fleet plan addendum within the scope ...", with the kept parts (no repricing, no bundle discount, every other sale keeps clause 1).
- evt_sale "a plan bought on its own is priced at plan_price_usd": plan_sale_rules "Status of clause 3(b)", first bullet, plus "Every other fleet plan bought on its own is still priced at the retail plan price, less the fleet volume discount ...".
- evt_cancellation_refund "Otherwise the refund follows the plan's refund_method" (total loss): cancellation_and_refund_clauses "Status of clause 7 — Opening ...", with the later-day carve-out and the clauses still in force.
- The 7(b) pro-rata clause (fleet, non-total-loss): "Status of clause 7 — Clause 7(b)".
- fleet_substitution "its expiration odometer is not reset": fleet_unit_substitution "Status of clause 3".

Each retired clause still has its bearing text marked as no longer in force in the declared scope. No undeclared retirement was found. The clauses not named stay stated as in force.

**maintenance_ext_fleet_addendum_price.**
- Scope / replaced_by / pricing date / writing terms: fleet_addendum_signing (Scope; "How the addendum is written").
- Baseline (basis = plan_price_usd, rounded half up) and the assembly (rate once, credits summed, floor 0.00, round at end): fleet_addendum_price_sheet.
- Factors, full ladders with figures:
  - unit_basis: fleet_addendum_basis_factory_overlap (3 tiers, months/miles shares, never below 0, mileage-limit "expiration odometer recorded as 0").
  - account_standing: fleet_account_standing_rate (Net 30 0.03 / Net 15 0.015 / late-fee or other: none; window "fewer than 12 whole months").
  - new_unit_enrollment: new_unit_enrollment_allowance (≤30: 40.00; 31–90: 20.00; >90: none).
  - account_tenure: fleet_tenure_credit_schedule (≥96: 30.00; 36–95: 15.00).
  - loss_replacement: total_loss_replacement_credit (<1 mo: 60.00; 1–<3: 30.00; else/none: none; plan = the one named on the most recent signed total-loss request, ties by registration time).
  - service_spend: fleet_service_spend_credit (≥5000: 40.00; 500–<5000: 20.00; as charged, before credit, deductibles excluded).

**maintenance_ext_fleet_cancel_refund.**
- Scope / overwrite / processing effects / tool: fleet_plan_cancellation_desk.
- Baseline + assembly: fleet_cancellation_refund_worksheet ("purchase price times the fleet refund share, rounded half up ... less the fleet cancellation fee"; share = unused/included; fee = the Fleet cancellation fee; deductions/credits on the rounded share amount; floor at end; free look / unwound replace).
- Factors:
  - usage_share: fleet_refund_usage_share (3 rows in order, 5000-mile interval stated, last recorded visit reading defined, three shares defined).
  - net_terms_fee: fleet_cancellation_fee_net_terms (10.00 / 15.00 / plan fee).
  - filter_visits: fleet_filter_visit_deduction (≥12: 90.00; 6–11: 45.00; <6: nothing; net used = redeemed − reinstated).
  - discount_recapture: fleet_volume_discount_recapture (<12: 1.0; 12–23: 0.5; ≥24 or sold at list: none; rounded half up).
  - fleet_tenure_refund: fleet_tenure_refund_credit (≥60: 20.00; 24–59: 10.00).
  - unit_service_history: fleet_unit_service_credit (≥3: 30.00; 1–2: 15.00; none; customer-pay labor only, deductibles excluded, plan's own unit).

**maintenance_ext_total_loss_refund.**
- Scope / overwrite / processing effects / tool: total_loss_cancellation_desk.
- Baseline + assembly: total_loss_refund_calculation (standard refund by method, rounded half up; no fee; credits added; floor then cap at purchase price; free look / unwound replace).
- Factors:
  - loss_share: total_loss_share_method (3 rows, 12/12 months, average of shares, highest recorded reading = max(check-in, delivery odometer)).
  - loss_courtesy: total_loss_courtesy_credit (fleet no late fee 25.00; fleet with late fee or Gold/Platinum 10.00; other none).
  - replacement_purchase: replacement_purchase_bonus (net vehicle-price charges <1 mo 30.00, <3 mo 15.00, per-window netting).
  - plan_relationship: plan_relationship_credit (deal 20.00; own + ≥1 RO line 10.00; else none).

**maintenance_ext_fleet_transfer_odometer.**
- Scope / overwrite / effects / tool: fleet_plan_move_desk.
- Baseline + assembly: moved_plan_expiration_odometer (start + miles left, whole miles; miles left never below 0; closing = last recorded visit reading; start = delivery odometer; "Mileage allowances that apply are added to that sum").
- Factors:
  - closing_reading_source: retired_unit_closing_reading (check-in above / Basic-warranty claim above / last reading).
  - starting_reading_source: replacement_unit_starting_reading (check-in / home delivery less distance, ≥0 / delivery odometer).
  - account_transfer_allowance: transfer_mileage_allowance (1000 / 500 / none).
  - unused_visit_allowance: remaining_visit_mileage_allowance (≥6: 3000; 3–5: 1500; <3: none).
  - booking_delay: booking_delay_allowance (>60: 2000; 31–60: 1000; ≤30: none).

Every tier, threshold, window and method step above is carried as the source pins it. Authoring fields (baseline / evidence / cross_difficulty / condition / resolved_by / effect) appear nowhere.

## kb_to_source
Sentence-level reverse pass over all 57 docs.

Every normative claim maps to a base rule, variant parameter, measure, extended rule, overwrite or tool contract. Explanatory restatements were checked and are entailed by their sources:
- "The recorded request is the authority, not a statement made in conversation": signed_request authority system_record.
- "judged from the system's plan records ...": one_plan_per_vehicle authority.

- "Retail tiers allow no substitution": fleet_substitution_max_per_plan 0.

- Additions (confirmations, reviews, notifications, procedures not in the source): none.
- Rewrites / omissions: none.
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …"): none. Each desk names only its own tool in its own invocation block.
- World state written as policy: none. All worked examples are labelled hypothetical, and none carries a figure equal to a scored value (checked against 43130 / 498.96 / 331.89 / 515.57 and their intermediates 433.96, 434.21, 686.15, 665.57; none appears). The unlock schemas carry no figures.

## dependency_form
- The blind hops were all **state-derived**; none was pre-solved.
- The three prerequisite sentences appear only in their blocked hubs. They appear nowhere else in the maintenance, warranty or loaner corpora. A regex sweep for ordering/route wording ("only after", "not written until", "first cancel/move", "then sign", tool names) over docs/maintenance finds only the three sentences and each desk's own tool block.

- Computation docs (fleet_addendum_price_sheet, fleet_cancellation_refund_worksheet, total_loss_refund_calculation, moved_plan_expiration_odometer) carry the source's own assembly sentence ("Where a rate applies … dollar credits that apply"; "Deductions that apply … credits that apply"; "Credits that apply …"; "Mileage allowances that apply …"). None names, lists or points at a factor; there is no "unless otherwise provided" and no exception list. Each worked example uses invented rates and credits labelled as such.
- Factor docs state ladders as rules. None says which tier a customer or most customers fall on, names the computation doc or another factor, or writes a task's evidence rows in as facts.
- Titles are general subjects. The hubs name the request type of an on_request policy ("Plan Addendum Bought on Its Own") or the event they govern ("Moving a … Plan to a Replacement Unit", "Total-Loss Cancellations", "Cancelling a … Fleet 12-Visit Plan").

It states no tier for any customer, mirrors no request and states no dependency, so it is not counted.
- Findability: KB_search with record words returns the move/closing/starting/allowance docs for "fleet plan retired unit replacement unit moved expiration odometer". "Commercial Fleet Account Net 30 maintenance plan cancellation refund" returns the net-terms/standing/courtesy/transfer/tenure docs. Every factor doc names its record source (Service Accounts and Repair Orders, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage) and the record words (tier names, "title", "check-in", "vehicle price charges").

### Settlement of the revision_1 policy-side note (loss_replacement COUNT scope)
- In check_compute's sandbox, `COUNT(table, …)` adds `eq[holding_pk] = HID`, so it reads only the target holding's ledger rows.
- The addendum computation's target_holding_id is 3f4887c1 (KC-329804). That is exactly the Fleet 12-Visit plan named on the customer's most recent, and only, signed total-loss request 34a05c14.
- So the COUNT reads the plan the rule names. **It is not a rule-vs-compute member; the note is withdrawn.**
